overview_description.description:
Authologic is a system that helps businesses in checking the identity of their clients online.

Authologic is a provider of identity verification solutions that includes tools for determining identity through online video, data, and digital IDs.

Krzysztof Klimczak, Jarek Sygitowicz, and Marek Rogoziński founded Authologic in 2020 and is based in Warsaw, Poland.

about_short_description.short_description: Authologic is a system that helps businesses in checking the identity of their clients online.

product.name: OmniID
product.description: An identity infrastructure platform that connects businesses to digital wallets, national eIDs, biometrics, document verification, bank-based verification, and other identity methods through one integration.

product.name: Automated KYC, KYB & AML Verification
product.description: A verification service that automates customer and business identity checks using eIDs, digital wallets, biometrics, documents, bank-based verification, and connected identity providers.

product.name: OmniPanel
product.description: A customer platform for configuring identity-verification journeys, applying brand customization, and monitoring verification activity and conversion performance in real time.

product.name: SDK & WebSDK
product.description: Embedded software components for adding Authologic’s identity-verification widget to websites and applications.

product.name: OmniLink API
product.description: An API integration option for connecting business applications to Authologic’s identity-verification methods and receiving verified identity attributes.

product.name: Single Secure Confirmation of Data
product.description: A secure electronic service that lets individuals confirm selected personal data through verification tools and transmit the confirmed information to a participating business.
